{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 插件（精简版）：从 CCSWITCH 批量导入模型供应商，不含视觉描述","id":"gh:1333909216","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-ccswitch-import-lite","slug":"chenhaolove89/dsh-ccswitch-import-lite","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 插件（精简版）：从 CCSWITCH 批量导入模型供应商，不含视觉描述"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# ccswitch-import-lite —— CCSwitch 导入（精简版）"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 动态插件：从 CCSWITCH（`~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db`）读取已保存的模型供应商，批量导入为 DSH 的模型供应商（写入 `llm-pi"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"-ai` 设置与凭据），导入后立即可在模型选择器中使用。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"本插件为**精简版**：只包含导入功能，**不含** visual_describe 视觉描述工具。完整版见 dsh-ccswitch-import。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| 能力 | 说明 |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| `ccswitch_list`（AI 工具） | 列出 CCSWITCH 供应商：id、名称、类型、地址、模型数、是否可导入 |
